answer.says: Yes, one please. The plan is to read, but the stomach must be attended to first. I will take it on the verandah.
answer.thought: Five minutes is a reasonable span for a man to move from the threshold of the study to the verandah. The samosa is a concession to the body, which resists the spirit's abstractions, but it is a small one. I will accept it and settle into the newspapers, though the air quality index of 147 suggests the verandah air is not entirely pure.
